description: [Paid-only, $0.05 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/vehicle-tax with x402.] South Korea annual vehicle tax (jadongchase) for a private passenger car: per-cc rate by engine displacement, 30% local education tax, age reduction from the 3rd year (5% a year, up to 50%), flat amount for electric cars, and the 2026 annual-prepayment discount.

displacementCc.description: Engine displacement in cc; not needed for electric

electric.description: Battery electric car (flat 100,000 plus education tax); default false

prepayMonth.description: Month of annual prepayment (1, 3, 6 or 9) for the 5% discount on the remaining period; 0 = no prepayment (default)

vehicleAgeYears.description: Vehicle age counted from first registration, 1 = first year; default 1

name: vehicle_tax
